remaining_timeout_mode_gap.finding: Measured on this exact source in iteration 19: aggregate-018-001 and aggregate-019-001 both reach the 300.008s cap with 199 ok, 14 owned-root ERROR, 0 FAIL, kill inside supervisor's complete_final_sample. The remaining supervisor cost is dominated by mandated full-510 real guard work (validate_result ~16s x ~5 across complete_final_sample/result_summary/deadline_steps accept-after-read paths) plus deadline_steps' 114 re-qualifying callbacks (~0.7s each, mandated monotone re-qualification of retained rows). The memo reduces repeated same-content qualification but cannot reduce distinct-row mandated guard work. The owned-environment launch resolves only the 14 environmental errors (fast owned KeyError path in s1_recovery); the supervisor wall time is environment-independent, so the 300s timeout-mode cap is still expected on this source in either environment. Plan059 §4 records this as the measured result rather than fabricating a fit; reducing mandated full-510 guard work is out of Plan059 scope.
